**Alarm root `alm-png-2026-05-21-0014` (LOS_SDH):**
- NE: Huawei OptiX OSN 9800 (`ne-png-tx-038`), site Bayan Baru

- 1 minor PERF_DEG

Setuju. Suppression rule scope site, conditions alarm_codes BTS_OOS + CELL_DOWN untuk site Bayan Baru, tempoh sehingga 6 AM esok. Name 'png-bayan-baru-tx-suppression'.
